A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same survey. Their main text, figures, tables, pseudocode, equations, and appendices A–F are readable and support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 presents a literature survey and descriptive taxonomy. Empirical outcomes, including those in the appendices, are attributed to cited studies rather than experiments or data analyses performed by this work.

after.justification: v2 remains a literature survey. Its additions provide definitions, literature context, and future research directions, without original empirical results.

M1.justification: The five-stage active-learning framework is retained. Algorithm 1 adds a membership check before removing an instance from the unlabeled set, which is equivalent to the previous set subtraction. Renaming Terminate to Stop does not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Neither version introduces original training or evaluation coverage. Tables 3 and 5 and Appendix E retain the same surveyed applications and datasets.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the same surveyed methods. Newly discussed Ask-LLM is additional literature coverage, not an experimentally evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: No experimental protocol is introduced or revised. The settings summarized from cited studies in the appendices remain unchanged.

E4.justification: No ablation, robustness test, sensitivity analysis, or empirical case study is added or revised. The new multi-aspect-feedback discussion in Section 8 proposes future research.

E5.justification: No repeated-run or seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, significance tests, or statistical estimation procedures are added or revised.

E6.justification: Reported outcomes remain unchanged, including the 42.45-fold annotation-cost reduction in Appendix E.7 and 74% time reduction in E.8. Section 3.3 now emphasizes uncertainty sampling's few-shot underperformance, but the comparison favoring similarity-based sampling was already reported in v1's Appendix C.1.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation and Appendix E.2 certainty-gain equations are retained, with no new theorem, proof, or derivation. The added prose definition of an LLM clarifies terminology rather than introducing substantive mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, first-comprehensive-survey claim, querying/annotation taxonomy, and conclusion retain their central claims. More explicit training-cost motivation elaborates the existing efficiency argument.

C2.justification: v2 adds a specific challenge concerning multi-aspect feedback and overfitting to one feedback dimension. It also clarifies model roles and cold-start conditions, distinguishes training costs from labeling costs, and qualifies the main-text discussion of uncertainty sampling.

D1.justification: No implementation instructions, experimental hyperparameters, hardware specifications, training times, or code/data access information are added or revised.

R1.justification: v2 adds nine references, including discussion of Ask-LLM, optimal experimental design, and label-complexity work. It also explicitly distinguishes LLM generation from Angluin's membership-query setting. These are limited extensions of the existing research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 refines definitions and explanatory prose, renames Section 5 from Termination to Stopping, standardizes some method names, and updates affiliations. The overall section and appendix organization remains intact.

P2.justification: Figure 2 has small spacing and sizing adjustments, Algorithm 1 separates the dataset updates into additional lines, and Table 4 moves between columns. Both figures and all five tables retain their substantive contents.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves clarity through explicit model roles and generated-instance handling in Section 2 and Algorithm 1. Section 3.3 better aligns with Appendix C.1, while added literature context and the multi-aspect-feedback challenge strengthen the survey. Its core synthesis and reported evidence remain largely unchanged.
